miniProject.title: Replicated store with checked histories and repair evidence
miniProject.brief: Extend `loglab` with configurable replication policies, executable consistency contracts and version-aware repair. Reuse `net/`, `clock/`, `member/` and `storage/` on your machine, keeping controller-driven promotion distinct from consensus and convergence distinct from a legal client history.
steps: Build validated operation histories and independent register witness search in `history/`; distinguish sequential consistency from linearizability, pending effects, malformed input and inconclusive search. Compare fixtures with Knossos's register model, retaining witnesses, contradictions and a negative control that drops pending writes.

Add configurable write authority, read routing and acknowledgement policies in `replica/`. Replay topology-specific partitions against hand-derived contracts; record receipt, persistence, application, replies and lineage-scoped record lag, including a crash before persistence. Preserve explicit event schedules and independent model verdicts before timing runs.

Implement controller-driven promotion, stale-epoch rejection and snapshot-plus-suffix bootstrap. Check divergent-leader rejoin, empty replacements and retention gaps against a single-node replay oracle; preserve lost acknowledged suffixes. Add session frontiers with wait-or-fail routing, monotonic reads and writes, writes-follow-reads and context-loss regressions.

Implement dependency visibility, sibling dominance, restart-safe actors and versioned deletes against an event-ancestry oracle. Preserve skewed and equal-tag LWW losses, sibling-policy comparisons and unsafe-reclamation regressions. Retain Gossip Glomers Challenge 4 histories separately from dependency checks; optionally test incoming-context dotted replacement.

Implement fixed-membership read write-back and fixed-preference sloppy quorums; check pending-write inversion and disjoint fallback sets with your register checker. Add recipient-aware delayed, duplicate hinted handoff and version-aware read repair; keep an unread-key negative test and distinguish partition stalls from safety violations.

Build canonical, ordered, domain-separated Merkle comparison over versioned snapshots, including cold keys and tombstones. Compare differences and repaired state with a full-scan oracle; retain separate rebuild, comparison and transfer counters. Replay deterministic crash, failover, delete and duplicate-repair schedules without erasing earlier history violations.

After correctness gates, compare consistency, conflict and repair policies across repeated matched runs on your machine; validate extraction against hand-counted traces. Retain versions, workloads, seeds, latency distributions, outcomes, staleness, conflicts, repair bytes, acknowledged loss and convergence. Keep Gossip Glomers 3d/3e results separate, including negative trade-offs.
deliverables: The `replica/` implementation with explicit contracts, recovery boundaries and reusable deterministic schedules in `faults/`.
Validated `history/` fixtures, Knossos comparisons, independent model verdicts and negative-control regressions in `tests/`.
Raw traces and repeated-run comparisons in `reports/`, separating simulated ordering, measured timing, unsuccessful work and unobserved convergence.

checks.name: Knossos register model through Jepsen's pinned checker tutorial
checks.note: Cross-check register fixtures on your machine; retain model versions, outcome translation and verdicts. No remote provisioning is needed.

checks.name: Gossip Glomers Challenge 4: Grow-Only Counter
checks.note: Retain Maelstrom histories and final-count verdicts; these do not establish causal visibility or intermediate-read linearizability.

checks.name: Gossip Glomers Challenge 3d: Efficient Broadcast, Part I
checks.note: Retain broadcast correctness and efficiency results separately from deterministic crash and storage evidence.

checks.name: Gossip Glomers Challenge 3e: Efficient Broadcast, Part II
checks.note: Compare matched broadcast workloads and recheck partitions; distinguish observed stability from client response latency.

rubric.pass: Your checker agrees with Knossos on legal, illegal and pending-write fixtures, returns witnesses, and separates invalid input and incomplete search from violations.
rubric.strong: A deliberately broken pending-write rule fails its negative control; minimized counterexamples identify the violated ordering edge without inspecting implementation state.

rubric.pass: Your ancestry oracle checks sibling dominance and deletes; full-scan comparison validates Merkle repair. Tests expose LWW loss, resurrection, sloppy nonintersection and the unread-key limitation.
rubric.strong: Metadata-only differences, duplicate handoff and restarted actors remain correct; an optional dotted extension removes only siblings covered by the incoming context.

rubric.pass: Hand-counted fixtures validate your extractor before repeated matched runs; raw histories support latency, outcomes, lag, conflict, repair, loss and convergence claims with named versions and workloads.
rubric.strong: The comparison preserves a negative regime, separates repair construction from transfer costs and reports pending operations or unobserved convergence rather than inventing completion times.

miniProject.feedsInto: Replication contracts, repair state and checked histories feed consensus, partition movement and stream visibility; durable traces, loss boundaries and matched comparisons become the capstone's replication evidence.
